command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./data -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; ls -la data | head -50; wc -c docs/*; cat docs/overview.md
cd /app/docs; cat election.md records.md counting.md output.md changelog.md

cd /app; cat tests/test_tally.py tools/check_tally.py | head -150; ls data/cvr | head; head -c 1500 data/election.json; for f in $(ls data/cvr/* | head -4); do echo == $f; head -8 $f; done; cat tests/fixtures/write_ins/input/cvr/scan_0412.csv
cd /app; mkdir -p out; python3 bin/tally.py data out/tally.json && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -15; python tools/check_tally.py

cd /app; echo '{"status": "success", "summary": "Wrote /app/bin/tally.py implementing the documented rules (batch revisions, write-ins, withdrawn/repeat/overvote reading, rounds, tie-breaks) and generated /app/out/tally.json. Unit tests pass and check_tally.py matches all 7 contests and 31 rounds."}' > STATUS.json; python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('STATUS.json')))"
